name: house-conventions
description: The standing conventions for an AWS lambda service fleet, from both ends: fleet-conventions is the rules in force (naming and its 64-character caps, route shape, outbound URL config, the one authorization gate, epoch-ms data rules, lambdas-only compute, the ten deploy gates) and service-blueprint is the job of standing up a new service from nothing, with the naming, deploy and URL-resolver templates it copies.
